articles.title: U.S. Treasury’s FinCEN Confirms Cyberattack, Takes Systems Offline After Unauthorized Access
articles.summary:
The U.S. Treasury Department’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) has taken some systems offline after confirming unauthorized access to a limited part of its network. The bureau said the shutdown was a precaution while it investigates the cyberattack. Its Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) E-Filing website remains operational, but some services may be temporarily unavailable. articles.summary:

articles.title: Task Management App Todoist Hacked, Attackers Breach Production Systems
articles.summary:
Task management app Todoist said an attacker breached its production systems on November 23, 2026, and downloaded account records for about 6% of its users. The records contained email addresses, account creation dates, and older password hashes, not plaintext passwords. articles.summary:

The attacks affected companies and critical infrastructure operators across at least two sectors.
